process.label: Step-by-step custom build
process.heading: How We Work with Brands
process.step1Desc: Choose structured or unstructured frames, and specify fabrics from heavy cotton to canvas or velvet.
process.step2Desc: Submit your high-resolution logos. Our designers will deliver a 3D digital mockup within 24 hours.
process.step3Desc: We produce a physical sample and send you detailed videos/photos for final adjustment approval.
process.step4Desc: We manufacture bulk orders and send regular progress media updates. 100% inspected before shipping.

qc.label: Rigid Quality Assurance
qc.heading: Our 5-Stage Strict QC Protocol
qc.step1Desc: Every roll of heavy cotton twill, organic canvas, and embroidery thread is checked for color consistency and tensile strength before cutting.
qc.step2Desc: Real-time monitoring of 3D puff embroidery height and stitch density. We immediately reject any piece with frayed edges or misaligned logos.
qc.step3Desc: Focus on crown structure and seam tape. We ensure internal sweatbands are aligned to within 1mm for maximum comfort and durability.
qc.step4Desc: Every single cap undergoes a final manual inspection, thread trimming, and high-pressure steam ironing before reaching the packing line.
qc.step5Desc: Final count verification against the packing list and shipping label audit to ensure 100% accuracy in international logistics.

faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.sub: Everything you need to know about our factory custom process.
faq.q0: What is your Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for custom baseball caps?
faq.a0: Our standard MOQ is 200 pieces per style/color. We also accommodate smaller test orders for initial brand startups and custom embroidery trials.
faq.q1: Can I get a sample before bulk production?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely! We provide physical pre-production samples. We can also provide free 3D digital mockups within 12 hours once you submit your artwork.
faq.q2: Do you manufacture hats based on custom designs (OEM/ODM)?
faq.a2: Yes. Baoding Junyang is a full-service OEM/ODM factory. We can construct caps from your sketches, spec sheets, or reverse-engineer physical original samples.
faq.q3: What is your standard production lead time?
faq.a3: Our sample production takes 7 days. Bulk mass production takes 15-20 days depending on the quantity and complexity. Global shipping via air takes 5-8 days.
